title: Restricted Fourier estimator run distribution
statement: Let $n$ and $m$ be natural numbers, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $S\subseteq J$, and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$. The estimator’s run law is that of drawing three independent uniformly random sequences $z,y,y'\in(\{−1,1\}^n)^m$ and returning its restricted Fourier weight estimate computed from these sequences and $f$. Every outcome has the estimator’s specified cost $\bigl(0,2m,3mn+m(2+2n+2|S|+1)+(m+1)\bigr)$.
